content: {"argument": "The witness test expects stripping 'www.' from hostnames with two-letter TLDs like '.co', but the changed regex now requires TLDs to be at least three characters long ({3,63}), which excludes valid two-letter TLDs. This change is overly restrictive and unintentionally breaks functionality for legitimate domains, as the original regex allowed TLDs of length 2 or more ({2,63}). The PR title mentions refactoring edge handling, but this alteration introduces a regression by incorrectly failing to strip 'www.' for two-letter TLDs, which was previously working.", "concedes": true}
